messages:
alex.k: Heads-up — plan to deprecate keystore v1 (old envelope header) with an 8-week grace period starting next Monday. Need to align on RBAC changes, audit schema/retention, and provider edge-cases (AWS/GCP/Azure). @maya can you drive the RBAC doc? :eyes:

maya: yep I can. quick Q — do we want a separate role for manual rewrap/rollforward or reuse 'kms-admin'? prefer least privilege.

eugene: strongly prefer separate role 'keystore-rewrap'. lowers blast radius and makes audits cleaner. also want audit events for 'rewrap.trigger' and 'rewrap.rollback' with keystore_version, initiator, and provider.

sara: +1 to separate role. also we should record caller_identity and key_metadata in logs for cross-cloud forensics (aws ARN vs gcp serviceAccount vs azure objectId). schema suggestion: 
```
{"event":"rewrap.trigger","keystore":"v1->v2","initiator":"alex.k","provider":"aws","key_alias":"alias/redwood-prod"}
```

jen-sec: don't forget Azure Key Vault managed identities — they give object ids. add provider_specific.identity. also ensure logs redact any plaintext key material.

alex.k: timing proposal: staged rollout — canary on Dedicated (low-traffic pools) week1, Private small customers week2-3, Hosted progressive week4-6. abort criteria: >0.5% rewrap error rate OR >2x tail latency for token generation. thoughts?

eugene: question on compatibility: rewrap changes envelope header version. do we keep read-path compatibility for v1 for how long? v2 producer, v1 reader?

maya: ops prefers 3 months for compatibility, security prefers longer. compromise: 6 months with telemetry gating — if v1 reads <5% by month 5 we can accelerate removal.

auditsvc: current histogram: keystore.v1_read_pct = 18.3% across hosts. will emit weekly snapshot to #eng-security and post a CSV to the shared drive.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy: keystore-migration v2 -> planned_start 2164200000 (canary pool)

sara: vuln-triage note: if rewrap fails mid-operation we could leave partial ciphertexts. rewrap must be idempotent and support a retry window. add a transaction id and safe-retry semantics to API. add to runbook.

alex.k: agree. action items: maya -> PR for RBAC role 'keystore-rewrap' (due in 3 days). eugene -> compatibility matrix & smoke tests for AWS/GCP/Azure (edge cases: multi-key aliases, KMS quotas, cross-region CMK access). sara -> idempotency + runbook. jen-sec -> audit schema PR and retention proposal. i'll draft rollout timeline + abort thresholds.

maya: pinging @eng-sre for observability hooks (traces, spans for rewrap) and retention policy decision.

sara: can someone estimate SLO impact for token-gen + rewrap (p50/p95/p99) so we can verify abort thresholds? need numbers before Friday.

alex.k: will gather initial perf numbers and reconvene Thu 10am. thanks all :thumbsup:
